dataset_info.description: Temple University Hospital clinical EEG corpus; routine recordings of mixed patients, no task or labels.
dataset_info.reference: Obeid, I., & Picone, J. (2016). The Temple University Hospital EEG Data Corpus. Frontiers in Neuroscience, 10, 196.
dataset_info.notes: Subset of 2634 EDF files from 605 patients. Channels = the 22 scalp sites of the 10-20 system found in every montage (old names T3/T4/T5/T6 resolve to T7/T8/P7/P8 in IO/dataset.py); a file missing one gets a zero row (padding). Subject ids = 1..N in patient-id order.
